第2352章 对峙联手（第1页）
金龙神皇哪能让牧帆就这么离开，瞬间化为一条金色巨龙，追了上去。
惊人的龙躯，超过数千里长，如一道庞然大物。
金龙神皇一边追赶，一边开口询问：“你是说，你这些日子，并没有杀害过我族人？”
牧帆脚下的速度不减，瞥了一眼后方追赶过来的金龙神皇，道：“我来这里只为寻求机缘，何必要杀你族人，给自己添麻烦？很明显，杀你族人的，另有其人，而并非是我。”
金龙神皇化为人形态，忽然停下了脚步，“本皇也实话告诉你吧，黑域平原内，确实出现过一道惊人的异象，但是我们已经查看过了，除了异象，并无其他，没有任何机缘和宝物之类的。”
牧帆也停下了步伐，转身看向金龙神皇，“既然来都来了，我肯定是要亲自去看一看的，倘若真没有什么机缘之类的，自然会离开黑域平原。”
“不仅是我，那些同样被天地异象吸引过来的强者，都不会因为你的一面之词而离开，肯定都会亲自去看一看，确认之后才会离开。”
这是事实，金龙神皇无法反驳，所以沉默不语。
牧帆继续说道：“你们远古生灵虽然熟悉这里，甚至已经更加适应这里的天地环境了，但是你们远古生灵的强者想必还不多吧？能够挡得住当今宇宙那么多强者进入这里？与其抵挡，不如让他们都进来，没有得到好处之后他们自然都会离开，若你们强行阻拦，只会爆发冲突，到时候你们还是阻止不了。”
金龙神皇道：“不可否认，你说的很有道理。”
就凭他和火凤神皇，确实挡不住那么多强者进入这里。
牧帆可不想继续被耽搁，于是立即飞离，继续朝着指引的方向而去。
这一次，金龙神皇并没有继续去追赶牧帆，而是停在了原地。
得到消息，金龙神皇五指紧握成拳，“看来，这些日子一直在杀我族人的，确实另有其人！”
长有三头的火凤神皇，与玄元界的三大强者，此时正在对峙着。
火凤神皇的实力，比金龙神皇都要厉害一大截，修为已经达到了天地永恒境巅峰。
洛天神王淡淡的笑道：“我们玄元界此行，只为寻找机缘，顺带杀个人，若你们远古生灵一族不识相，要阻拦我们，那么我们不介意连你们一同收拾了！”

他们人多势众，实力强横，可不会好好说话。
火凤神皇眉头紧锁，“你们要来杀一个人？”
洛天神王道：“他名牧帆，乾坤永恒境层次，战力却异常强大，远超同境界的乾坤永恒境，如果所料不差，他应该已经在这黑域平原内了。”
火凤神皇的三颗头颅，同时冒起了火焰，“原来你们要杀的人是那小子！他是不是很年轻？斩杀乾坤永恒境，如同喝水一般简单？”
洛天神王道，“阁下见过牧帆了？”
血刀神王双手抱胸，目光直盯着火凤神皇。
火凤神皇道：“并没有见过，但是却清楚，这小子已经斩杀我不少族人了，乾坤永恒境都死了三尊！本皇势必要斩杀此人！”
血刀神王见状，笑道：“这么看来，我们有一项目标是一致的，既然如此，何不联手？”

Chapter 2352 Confrontation and Alliance (Page 1)
How could the Golden Dragon God Emperor let Mu Fan leave like this? He instantly transformed into a golden dragon and chased after him.
The astonishing dragon body is more than thousands of miles long, like a behemoth.
As the Golden Dragon God Emperor chased after him, he asked, "You mean, you haven't killed any of my people these days?"
The speed of Mu Fan's feet did not slow down, and he glanced at the Golden Dragon God Emperor who was chasing behind him, and said: "I came here just to seek opportunities, why do I need to kill your tribe and cause trouble for myself? Obviously, there is someone else who killed your tribe, and it is not me."
The Golden Dragon God Emperor turned into a human form and suddenly stopped, "I will tell you the truth, an astonishing vision did appear in the Black Domain Plain, but we have already checked it, and there is nothing other than the vision. There is no opportunity or treasure."
Mu Fan also stopped and turned to look at the Golden Dragon God Emperor, "Since you are here, I will definitely go and have a look in person. If there is really no chance, I will naturally leave the Black Domain Plain."
"Not only me, but those powerful people who are also attracted by the vision of heaven and earth will not leave because of your words. They will definitely go and have a look in person and confirm before leaving."
This is a fact. The Golden Dragon God Emperor cannot refute it, so he remains silent.
Mu Fan continued: "Although you ancient beings are familiar with this place and have even become more adapted to the world and environment here, you must not be many strong ancient beings, right? Can you stop so many strong people in the current universe from entering here? Instead of resisting, it is better to let them all come in. If they don't get any benefits, they will naturally leave. If you forcefully block it, conflicts will only break out, and you still won't be able to stop it."
The Golden Dragon God Emperor said: "It is undeniable that what you said makes sense."
He and the Fire Phoenix God Emperor really can't stop so many powerful people from entering here.
Mufan didn't want to be delayed any longer, so he immediately flew away and continued in the direction shown.
This time, the Golden Dragon God Emperor did not continue to chase Mu Fan, but stopped where he was.
After receiving the news, the Golden Dragon God Emperor clenched his fingers into fists, "It seems that there is indeed someone else who has been killing my people these days!"
The three-headed Fire Phoenix God Emperor was confronting the three powerful men of the Xuanyuan Realm.
The Fire Phoenix God Emperor is much more powerful than the Golden Dragon God Emperor, and his cultivation has reached the peak of the Eternal Realm of Heaven and Earth.
Luotian Divine King smiled faintly and said: "We are here in Xuanyuan Realm just to find opportunities and kill someone by the way. If you, a clan of ancient creatures, are ignorant and want to stop us, then we don't mind taking care of you too!"
They are numerous and powerful, but they don't know how to speak well.
The Fire Phoenix God Emperor frowned, "You want to kill someone?"
King Luotian God said: "His name is Mu Fan, he is at the level of Qiankun Eternal Realm, but his combat power is extremely powerful, far exceeding the same level of Qiankun Eternal Realm. If the prediction is correct, he should already be in this black plain."
The three heads of the Fire Phoenix God Emperor burst into flames at the same time, "So the person you want to kill is that boy! Is he very young? Killing the eternal realm of Qiankun is as easy as drinking water?"
King Luotian asked, "Has your Excellency met Mu Fan?"
The Blood Knife God King crossed his arms and stared directly at the Fire Phoenix God Emperor.
The Fire Phoenix God Emperor said: "I have never seen it, but I know that this boy has killed many of my clan members, and three of them have died in the Qiankun Eternal Realm! I must kill this person!"
Seeing this, the Blood Knife God King smiled and said: "It seems that we have the same goal. In this case, why not join forces?"
